title: Beyond Waypoint Regression: Query-Based Cost Learning over Reachable Ego Futures for End-to-End Driving
title_zh: 超越航点回归：基于可达自我未来轨迹的查询式成本学习，用于端到端驾驶

paragraphs.en: End-to-end planners based on waypoint regression achieve strong open-loop accuracy, but they primarily learn to mimic expert geometry and remain difficult to adapt to deployment-time safety constraints. We propose a query-based cost-learning framework that estimates bounded costs for dynamically reachable ego trajectory queries, rather than dense BEV cells or a small regressed trajectory set. Compact joint scene tokens capture coherent multimodal agent futures, while contingency-aware cost aggregation and cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI mixing convert the learned cost topology into feasible ego plans. On nuScenes, our method improves over prior cost-estimation planners such as ST-P3 and NMP, outperforms most regression baselines in collision rate, while remaining competitive in L2, and retaining an interpretable cost interface. On real-world driving logs, the proposed planner reduces collision rates compared with SparseDrive and Alpamayo without fine-tuning, while maintaining a diverse set of candidate trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 基于航点回归的端到端规划器虽然实现了强大的开环精度，但它们主要学习模仿专家几何结构，因此难以适应部署时的安全约束。 我们提出了一种基于查询的成本学习框架，该框架为动态可达的自身轨迹查询估算有界成本，而非为密集的BEV单元格或小型回归轨迹集估算成本。 紧凑的联合场景令牌能够捕捉到连贯的多模态智能体未来状态，而考虑突发情况的成本聚合与成本引导的簇内MPPI混合，则将学习到的成本拓扑转化为可行的自身规划方案。 在nuScenes数据集上，我们的方法优于ST-P3和NMP等先前的成本估计规划器，在碰撞率方面超越了大多数回归基线模型，同时在L2指标上保持竞争力，并保留了可解释的成本接口。 在真实世界的驾驶日志中，所提出的规划器无需微调即可降低与SparseDrive和Alpamayo相比的碰撞率，同时保持了多样化的候选轨迹集。

paragraphs.en: End-to-End (E2E) driving has progressed from direct sensor-to-control learning [ 11 , 2 ] to unified systems that jointly learn perception, prediction, and planning [ 5 , 10 ] . Recent sparse representations make these systems more scalable by allocating capacity to compact task- or instance-level tokens instead of dense raster features [ 13 , 24 , 12 ] . However, the final planning interface remains a bottleneck: decisions should remain risk-aware, interpretable, physically feasible, and adaptable to deployment-time safety constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端（E2E）驾驶已从直接的传感器到控制的学习 [ 11 , 2 ] 发展为统一系统，这些系统能够联合学习感知、预测和规划 [ 5 , 10 ] 。 近期的稀疏表示方法通过为紧凑的任务级或实例级标记分配容量，而非密集的光栅特征，使这些系统更具可扩展性 [ 13 , 24 , 12 ] 。 然而，最终的规划接口仍然是瓶颈：决策必须保持风险感知、可解释、物理可行，并能适应部署时的安全约束。

paragraphs.en: Waypoint regression approaches are effective because they directly predict a short horizon of future ego motions. However, imitation objectives primarily reward spatial similarity to expert demonstrations and do not explicitly distinguish safe behavior from collision-causing hard negatives [ 26 ] . Consequently, regression planners are difficult to inspect or repair, may produce infeasible behavior under distribution shift, and weakly incorporate safety through post-hoc rescoring of a limited top- k k set. Cost maps offer a more abstract alternative by exposing a risk landscape that can be optimized, repaired, and combined with external costs at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 路径点回归方法之所以有效，是因为它们能直接预测短期内的未来自我运动。 然而，模仿目标主要奖励与专家演示在空间上的相似性，并未明确区分安全行为与可能导致碰撞的困难负样本 [ 26 ] 。 因此，回归规划器难以检查或修复，在分布偏移下可能产生不可行的行为，并且仅通过事后对有限的前 k 个样本进行重新评分来弱地融入安全性。 成本地图提供了一种更抽象的替代方案：它揭示了一个可被优化、修复并在运行时与外部成本相结合的风险景观。

paragraphs.en: Existing E2E cost-map planners such as Neural Motion Planner (NMP) [ 31 ] and ST-P3 [ 9 ] , however, estimate dense rasterized costs over many unreachable cells, spreading supervision away from feasible trajectories. Their flexibility has therefore often come at the cost of lower open-loop planning accuracy than direct regression. Moreover, many planners rely on marginal motion modes, which can ignore cross-agent correlations and miss scene-consistent interaction outcomes [ 23 ] . This motivates a cost representation that preserves the optimization benefits of cost maps while avoiding dense supervision over irrelevant space.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的端到端成本图规划器，例如 Neural Motion Planner (NMP) [ 31 ] 和 ST-P3 [ 9 ]，会在许多不可达的单元格上估算密集的光栅化成本，从而将监督信号从可行轨迹中分散开去。 因此，它们的灵活性往往是以比直接回归更低的开环规划精度为代价实现的。 此外，许多规划器依赖于边缘运动模式，这可能导致忽略智能体之间的相关性，并遗漏场景一致性的交互结果 [ 23 ]。 这促使我们提出一种成本表示方法，既能保留成本图的优化优势，又能避免在无关空间上进行密集的监督。

paragraphs.en: We propose a vectorized, query-based E2E cost planner that narrows this gap by learning a cost estimation over the reachable ego trajectories rather than over a dense spatial grid. The model estimates mode-conditioned costs for sampled ego trajectory queries from compact joint scene tokens built from vectorized map and agent representations. It then aggregates costs over coherent future scene modes with a contingency strategy and refines trajectories through cluster-based MPPI-style mixing guided by the learned cost topology. This design retains the flexibility of cost optimization while approaching regression-style accuracy and improving transfer to real-world driving. The key contributions of this work are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种基于查询的向量化端到端成本规划器，它通过针对可达的自我轨迹学习成本估计，而非在密集的空间网格上进行估计，从而缩小了这一差距。 该模型基于由向量化地图和智能体表示构建的紧凑联合场景标记，为采样出的自我轨迹查询估计模式相关的成本。 接着，它通过一种应急策略对连贯的未来场景模式进行成本聚合，并借助学习到的成本拓扑结构，通过基于聚类的 MPPI 风格混合来优化轨迹。 这种设计在保持成本优化灵活性的同时，接近了回归式的准确性，并提升了对真实世界驾驶场景的迁移能力。 本工作的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: E2E autonomous driving has advanced along two closely related directions: richer scene representations and more structured planning interfaces. Our work lies at their intersection, using compact sparse scene tokens while addressing the limitations of direct regression by estimating costs over reachable ego trajectories.

paragraphs.en: E2E driving has moved from intermediate-representation and sensor-fusion models, such as DSDNet [ 32 ] and TransFuser [ 5 ] , toward planning-oriented architectures such as UniAD [ 10 ] and DriveTransformer [ 12 ] . In parallel, vectorized and sparse representations have reduced the computation cost of dense BEV representations. MapTR introduced structured queries for online map reconstruction [ 19 ] ; VAD, SparseDrive, and SparseAD extend this idea to end-to-end driving with compact map and agent queries [ 13 , 24 , 33 ] . While these methods improve scene encoding and planning efficiency, the final decision is commonly obtained through trajectory regression. They also often reason over marginal agent modes, which can fail to capture coherent scene understanding and complex interactive futures [ 23 ] . In contrast, our planner learns a cost landscape over reachable ego trajectories conditioned on joint scene tokens, so each action is scored against coherent multimodal scene hypotheses rather than independently selected futures.

paragraphs.en: Cost-based planners provide an interpretable interface between perception and action by exposing a cost landscape that can be optimized or repaired. Neural Motion Planner [ 31 ] , QUAD [ 1 ] , and MP3 [ 4 ] estimate costs from BEV or map-conditioned features and score sampled ego trajectories, while ST-P3 learns a spatial-temporal BEV cost volume for multi-camera planning [ 9 ] . These works demonstrate the value of learned costs, but dense BEV cost supervision disperses learning over large regions that are irrelevant to the ego vehicle’s reachable motion. This can make optimization less stable, blur the distinction between reachable and unreachable costs, and has often led to weaker planning performance than direct regression.
paragraphs.zh: 基于成本的规划器通过揭示一个可优化或修复的成本景观，在感知与行动之间提供了一个可解释的接口。 Neural Motion Planner [ 31 ]、QUAD [ 1 ] 和 MP3 [ 4 ] 从 BEV 或地图条件特征中估计成本，并对采样出的自我轨迹进行评分，而 ST-P3 则为多摄像头规划学习了一个时空 BEV 成本体积 [ 9 ]。 这些工作展示了学习成本的价值，但密集 BEV 成本监督会将学习过程分散到与自我车辆可达运动无关的大区域上。 这可能导致优化稳定性下降、模糊可达成本与不可达成本之间的界限，并且通常会导致规划性能弱于直接回归方法。

paragraphs.en: In addition, cost learning is connected to Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL), which treats expert demonstrations as evidence of an underlying reward or cost function. Maximum-entropy IRL formalizes this idea by recovering costs whose induced trajectory distribution matches expert behavior [ 30 ] , with later extensions to spatial-temporal costmaps [ 16 , 15 , 25 ] . However, these methods usually supervise costs indirectly through expert likelihood or policy matching, often requiring an inner planning or policy-inference loop. On the other hand, purely supervised trajectory regression has safety limitations: Wang et al. [ 26 ] show that distance-to-expert losses fail to separate safe and collision-prone alternatives. We instead learn a query-based cost landscape in which expert behavior, collision risk, and off-road violations supervise the ordering of reachable ego queries.

paragraphs.en: The aggregated costs define a local cost topology over the sampled reachable set. Pure sampling provides broad coverage, but the hard selection remains limited by the resolution of the sampled set and can therefore suffer from high displacement error. Selecting only the global lowest-cost samples can also collapse to a single maneuver family. We address these limitations with cost-guided intra-cluster mixing: intention clusters preserve global maneuver diversity, while the learned risk-aware costs refine each cluster toward its low-cost region.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合后的成本在采样可达集上定义了一个局部成本拓扑。 纯采样虽然能实现广泛覆盖，但硬性选择仍受采样集分辨率的限制，因此可能产生较高的位移误差。 仅选择全局最低成本的样本也可能导致结果坍缩为单一机动族。 我们通过成本引导的簇内混合来解决这些局限性：意图簇保留了全局机动的多样性，而学习到的风险感知成本则使每个簇向其低成本区域优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the nuScenes dataset [ 3 ] , which contains 1000 driving scenes with six surround-view cameras and keyframe annotations at 2Hz. Using the train/validation split, the model observes a queue of four multi-view frames and produces a 3s future ego plan for open-loop evaluation. For zero-shot transfer, we use a subset of 465 driving logs from FZI-AURA [ 21 ] , each lasting 20s, totaling 2.58 hours of driving, about 3 × \times the duration of the nuScenes validation split. The logs were collected with the CoCar NextGen research vehicle [ 7 ] in Germany across different times of day, lighting conditions, and traffic densities. To reduce domain shift, we select six surround-view cameras and process the logs following a nuScenes-inspired protocol with manually annotated 3D bounding boxes and semantic segmentation labels. The vehicle uses a sensor rig similar in layout but not identical to nuScenes, resulting in slightly different camera intrinsics and extrinsics.

paragraphs.en: Our model uses SparseDrive-S [ 24 ] as the sparse perception backbone with a ResNet-50 FPN image encoder, 900 agent anchors, 100 map anchors, and 256-dimensional instance features. All variants of our model are trained with AdamW using a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and an effective batch size of 48 on two NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs. paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares open-loop planning performance on nuScenes. Compared with prior cost-based planners, our method substantially improves both displacement error and collision rate. Our query cost representation concentrates learning on reachable ego motions, the safety-margin loss separates unsafe hard negatives, and cost-guided cluster mixing converts the learned topology into accurate final plans. Against ST-P3, the average L2 error drops from 2.11m to 0.71m, while the average collision rate drops from 0.71% to 0.07%. This closes much of the gap to recent regression-based planners while preserving the advantages of an explicit cost interface. Notably, our method achieves a lower average collision rate than SparseDrive-S and remains close to the larger SparseDrive-B variant, while also outperforming most regression baselines such as VAD [ 13 ] and DriveTransformer [ 12 ] , suggesting that learning costs over reachable queries provides a useful balance between accurate imitation and safety-aware planning.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了 nuScenes 数据集上开环规划的性能。 与先前的基于成本的规划器相比，我们的方法显著降低了位移误差和碰撞率。 我们的查询成本表示将学习集中在可达的自身运动上，安全边际损失则分离出不安全的困难负样本，而成本引导的聚类混合则将学到的拓扑结构转化为精确的最终规划方案。 与 ST-P3 相比，平均 L2 误差从 2.11 米降至 0.71 米，而平均碰撞率从 0.71% 降至 0.07%。 这大大缩小了与近期基于回归的规划器之间的差距，同时保留了显式成本接口的优势。 值得注意的是，我们的方法实现了比 SparseDrive-S 更低的平均碰撞率，并且与规模更大的 SparseDrive-B 变体表现接近，同时还优于大多数回归基线模型，例如 VAD [13] 和 DriveTransformer [12]，这表明在可达查询上学习成本有助于在精确模仿和安全感知规划之间取得有效平衡。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 evaluates zero-shot transfer to real-world driving logs collected in Germany, without fine-tuning any method on this data. Alpamayo 1.5 [ 27 ] is a large vision-language driving model trained on substantially broader data, so we use it as a strong imitation-oriented reference rather than a lightweight planner baseline. Compared with SparseDrive-S, our method reduces the average L2 distance from 4.22m to 2.31m and the average collision rate from 2.73% to 0.68%. Alpamayo achieves the lowest displacement error, but uses a 10B-parameter model and requires 1.87s per frame on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU. In contrast, our 86.2M-parameter planner achieves the lowest collision rate, runs in real time, and maintains higher candidate diversity for downstream repair and selection. These results suggest that reachable-query cost learning provides a favorable balance between safety, diversity, and efficiency under real-world domain shift.
paragraphs.zh: 表2评估了零样本迁移到在德国收集的真实世界驾驶日志的效果，且未在此数据上对任何方法进行微调。 Alpamayo 1.5 [ 27 ] 是一种基于更广泛数据训练的大型视觉-语言驾驶模型，因此我们将其用作一个强大的模仿导向参考，而非轻量级的规划基线模型。 与 SparseDrive-S 相比，我们的方法将平均 L2 距离从 4.22 米降至 2.31 米，并将平均碰撞率从 2.73% 降至 0.68%。 Alpamayo 实现了最低的位移误差，但其模型包含 100 亿个参数，并且在 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU 上每帧需要 1.87 秒的运行时间。 相比之下，我们拥有 8620 万个参数的规划器实现了最低的碰撞率，能够实时运行，并能为下游的修复和选择过程保持更高的候选多样性。 这些结果表明，在真实世界的领域迁移场景下，可达查询成本学习能够在安全性、多样性和效率之间实现理想的平衡。

paragraphs.en: We next isolate how the safety margin shapes the learned cost topology. Table 3 first studies how the collision term in the margin is computed during training. All variants use the same architecture and cost planner at inference; only the collision signal used to compute the training margin changes. At test time, the margin itself is not required, since its effect is absorbed into the learned cost topology. Ground-truth collision provides an oracle target, while top-1 predicted collision supervises the margin using only the most likely future scene. In contrast, contingency collision risk is computed over multimodal predicted scene futures, allowing lower-probability but safety-critical futures to influence the learned costs.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们分析安全余量如何塑造学习到的成本拓扑结构。 表 3 首先研究了训练过程中余量中的碰撞项是如何计算的。 所有变体在推理阶段都使用相同的架构和成本规划器；唯一变化的是用于计算训练余量的碰撞信号。 在测试阶段，余量本身并不必要，因为其影响已被吸收进学习到的成本拓扑结构中。 真实碰撞数据提供了一个理想目标，而 top-1 预测的碰撞则仅基于最可能发生的未来场景来监督余量。 相比之下，应急碰撞风险是基于多模态预测的未来场景计算的，这使得概率较低但关键的安全相关未来场景也能影响学习到的成本。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 further decomposes the proposed margin. This evaluates the contribution of expert-distance and safety terms, and whether combining them yields a cost topology that is both safety-aware and useful for final planning. Using only collision and off-road terms produces the strongest raw separation, but it also degrades displacement and does not translate into the best final collision rate. paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates the inference-time cost repair introduced in Section 3.6 . Our planner instead applies the external penalty to the aggregated query-cost profile before intra-cluster mixing. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 qualitatively evaluates the behavior of the planners under a temporally misaligned high-level navigation command. The scene contains an S-bend before a highway merge: the route will soon require a right turn, but the vehicle must first follow a left-hand bend bounded by lane dividers. Thus, the command is not semantically wrong, but executing the right-turn intent immediately would cut into the divider. SparseDrive prematurely shifts its selected trajectory toward the upcoming right maneuver and collides with the divider, as seen in Fig. 4(b) . This reflects a limitation of command-conditioned trajectory regression: the generated proposal follows the route intent in geometry, but does not explicitly optimize a local road-compliance cost.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 从定性角度评估了规划器在时间上不同步的高层导航指令下的行为。 该场景包含一个 S 形弯道，之后是高速公路的汇入口：路线很快需要右转，但车辆必须首先沿着由车道分隔带围成的左转弯道行驶。 因此，该指令在语义上并无错误，但若立即执行右转意图，则会切入分隔带。 SparseDrive 过早地将所选轨迹转向即将到来的右转操作，并与分隔带发生碰撞，如圖 4(b) 所示。 这反映了指令条件化轨迹回归的一个局限性：生成的候选轨迹在几何结构上遵循了路线意图，但并未显式优化局部道路合规性成本。

paragraphs.en: This work revisits cost-based planning as an end-to-end driving interface by learning bounded costs over dynamically reachable ego trajectories rather than dense BEV grids. This shifts supervision toward actions the vehicle can actually execute, while retaining a cost representation that can be inspected, optimized, and repaired. Compact joint scene tokens, safety-aware ranking, and cost-guided cluster mixing support reasoning over coherent future contingencies and produce safe ego plans. On nuScenes, the approach substantially improves over previous cost-based planners and remains competitive with strong regression-based approaches. Zero-shot transfer to FZI-AURA demonstrates effectiveness without fine-tuning, while the cost interface provides a mechanism for inference-time repair using external safety signals.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作重新审视了基于成本的规划方法，将其视为一种端到端的驾驶接口：通过学习动态可达的自身轨迹上的有界成本，而非依赖密集的BEV网格。 这将监督重点转向车辆实际可执行的动作，同时保留了可被检查、优化和修复的成本表示形式。 紧凑的联合场景标记、安全感知排序以及成本引导的聚类混合，支持对连贯未来情景的推理，并生成安全的自身规划方案。 在nuScenes数据集上，该方法显著优于先前的基于成本的规划器，并且与强大的回归基线方法相比仍具有竞争力。 对FZI-AURA的零样本迁移无需微调即可展现有效性，同时成本接口为推理时的修复提供了利用外部安全信号的机制。

paragraphs.en: High-level navigation commands are generated from the recorded future ego motion using the same virtual frame. For each evaluated frame, we transform the ego displacement after 3 s into the virtual top-lidar frame and apply the SparseDrive lateral-threshold rule. Displacements greater than 2 m are labeled right , displacements below − 2 -2 m are labeled left , and the remaining frames are labeled straight . This yields a command distribution of 8% left, 83.5% straight, and 8.5% right. For Alpamayo, we convert the same command labels into text prompts so both methods receive the same high-level intent.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Alpamayo 1.5 [ 27 ] as a large imitation-oriented vision-language driving reference rather than as a lightweight real-time planner baseline. Alpamayo is evaluated using only the front-medium camera. It receives four image history frames and 16 ego-history states sampled at 10 Hz, corresponding to 1.6 s of ego-state history. In contrast, SparseDrive and our method receive four multi-view frames at 2 Hz. The same navigation-command heuristic is used for Alpamayo as for the SparseDrive-format methods, with the discrete labels converted into natural-language instructions: “Turn left”, “Go straight”, or “Turn right”. Alpamayo inference is run on the 10 Hz raw logs with stride 5, giving the same 2 Hz evaluation rate as the labeled keyframes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Alpamayo 1.5 [ 27 ] 视为一种大型模仿导向的视觉-语言驾驶参考模型，而非轻量级的实时规划基线模型。 Alpamayo 仅使用前中置摄像头进行评估。 它接收四个历史图像帧和以 10 Hz 采样的 16 个自身状态历史，对应于 1.6 秒的自身状态历史。 相比之下，SparseDrive 和我们的方法接收以 2 Hz 频率的多视角图像帧。 Alpamayo 与采用 SparseDrive 格式的方法使用相同的导航指令启发式规则，其中离散标签被转换为自然语言指令：“左转”、“直行”或“右转”。 Alpamayo 的推理在 10 Hz 的原始日志上以步长 5 运行，从而获得与带标签的关键帧相同的 2 Hz 评估速率。

paragraphs.en: Predicted trajectories are generated for a 3 s horizon and exported into the same SparseDrive-style result format used by the other methods. Alpamayo 1.5 can sample one or more future trajectories, but the released model does not expose a model-defined trajectory-level cost, confidence, likelihood, or score for ranking those samples. Therefore, L2 and collision are computed using the first decoded trajectory. For candidate-diversity evaluation, we collect 16 sampled trajectories per frame. The samples are generated sequentially due to GPU memory limitations. For the real-world transfer table in the main paper, latency is measured with a single generated trajectory per frame.
paragraphs.zh: 预测轨迹在 3 秒的时间范围内生成，并以其他方法使用的相同 SparseDrive 风格结果格式导出。 Alpamayo 1.5 可以采样一个或多个未来轨迹，但已发布的模型并未提供模型定义的轨迹级成本、置信度、可能性或分数来对这些样本进行排序。 因此，L2 和碰撞检测是基于第一条解码出的轨迹计算的。 在候选多样性评估中，我们每帧收集 16 个采样轨迹。 由于 GPU 内存限制，这些样本是依次生成的。 对于主论文中的现实世界迁移表，延迟的测量基于每帧单个生成的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We report the standard open-loop L2 and collision metrics at 1s, 2s, and 3s. Unless otherwise stated, these metrics are computed on the final selected trajectory for each planner. SparseDrive selects the trajectory with the highest planning score, whereas our method selects the refined candidate with the lowest aggregated query cost. Following the uniAD [ 10 ] protocol, each reported collision value is cumulative over the 0.5s evaluation steps up to the corresponding horizon. Collision is evaluated by intersecting the predicted ego footprint with future annotated 3D bounding boxes in the ego-aligned evaluation frame. Map-based road-compliance signals are used outside the reported open-loop L2 and collision metrics. On nuScenes, boundary violations are used during training to construct the safety-aware ranking margin: a violation is counted when the predicted ego trajectory, evaluated with footprint offsets, crosses drivable-area boundary polylines extracted from lane and road-segment polygons. On the real-world logs, where the same HD-map protocol is not available, we build an accumulated semantic-lidar road-support map for qualitative visualization and sanity checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 1s、2s 和 3s 时报告标准的开环 L2 指标和碰撞指标。 除非另有说明，这些指标均基于每个规划器最终选定的轨迹计算得出。 SparseDrive 会选择规划得分最高的轨迹，而我们的方法则会选择聚合查询成本最低的优化候选轨迹。 遵循 uniAD [ 10 ] 协议，每个报告的碰撞值都是截至对应时间范围前 0.5s 评估步骤的累积值。 碰撞评估通过将预测的自身车辆足迹与评估帧中未来标注的 3D 边界框求交集进行判断，该评估帧已与自身车辆坐标系对齐。 基于地图的道路合规性信号未被纳入所报告的开环 L2 指标和碰撞指标之外。 在 nuScenes 数据集上，边界违规情况被用于训练过程中构建安全感知排名余量：当预测的自身车辆轨迹（经足迹偏移评估后）穿过从车道和道路段多边形中提取的可行驶区域边界折线时，即计为一次违规。 在真实世界日志中，由于无法使用相同的 HD 地图协议，我们构建了一个累积的语义激光雷达道路支持地图，用于定性可视化和合理性检查。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 compares global lowest-cost selection, best-per-cluster selection, MPPI mixing, and MPPI mixing with learned rescoring of the fused trajectories. paragraphs.en: The rescoring experiment tests whether evaluating the fused trajectory with the learned cost head improves selection over the cluster-desirability proxy. paragraphs.en: Table 8 ablates the planner-specific losses while keeping the same reachable-query architecture. A similar trend appears for contingency collision risk, where Top- k k aggregation reduces the average collision rate from 0.13% to 0.07% and improves both cost AUC and cost gap. This suggests that when the collision signal is reliable or contingency-aware, spreading gradients across several hard negatives yields a smoother and more useful cost topology than optimizing only the worst single violation.

paragraphs.en: The top-1 predicted collision signal behaves differently: max aggregation yields a lower collision rate than Top- k k , likely because a single predicted future provides a narrower, noisier safety target. paragraphs.en: Table 10 evaluates which learned cost profile is used to compute the MPPI-style cluster weights. The mean trajectory cost first averages the cost over the horizon and uses a single score for each sampled trajectory, giving the refinement a trajectory-level preference. The per-timestep cost instead computes weights independently at each future step, which is more local but can combine controls from different samples at different timesteps.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 评估了用于计算 MPPI 风格聚类权重的已学习成本配置文件。 平均轨迹成本首先对时间范围内的成本进行平均，并为每条采样轨迹使用单个得分，从而为优化过程赋予轨迹级别的偏好。 而每时步成本则在未来每个步骤中独立计算权重，这种方式更具局部性，但可以将不同时步中来自不同样本的控制指令结合起来。

sents.en: Table 10 evaluates which learned cost profile is used to compute the MPPI-style cluster weights.
sents.zh: 表 10 评估了用于计算 MPPI 风格聚类权重的已学习成本配置文件。

sents.en: The per-timestep cost instead computes weights independently at each future step, which is more local but can combine controls from different samples at different timesteps.
sents.zh: 而每时步成本则在未来每个步骤中独立计算权重，这种方式更具局部性，但可以将不同时步中来自不同样本的控制指令结合起来。

paragraphs.en: The two variants obtain the same cost AUC, indicating a similar safe-versus-unsafe ordering. The difference appears in how this topology is used for refinement: the mean trajectory cost reduces the average L2 from 0.77 to 0.71 and the average collision from 0.14% to 0.07%. This suggests that intra-cluster mixing benefits from a temporally consistent trajectory-level preference. Per-timestep weighting is more flexible, but in a finite sampled cluster, it can assemble a control sequence from samples that are locally low-cost at different times but do not form a coherent maneuver. We therefore use the mean trajectory cost as the default profile for cost-guided intra-cluster mixing.
paragraphs.zh: 两种变体获得了相同的成本 AUC，表明它们在安全与不安全状态上的排序相似。 差异体现在这种拓扑结构在优化中的使用方式：平均轨迹成本将平均 L2 从 0.77 降低到 0.71，并将平均碰撞率从 0.14% 降低到 0.07%。 这表明，簇内混合受益于一种在时间上一致的轨迹级偏好。 每个时间步的加权方式更灵活，但在有限的采样簇中，它可能会从不同时间点局部低成本但无法形成连贯操作的样本中组合出控制序列。 因此，我们将平均轨迹成本用作成本引导的簇内混合的默认配置。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 ablates how the scene-mode costs are aggregated before cluster mixing. Top-1 aggregation uses only the most likely scene mode, worst-case aggregation takes the maximum over scene modes, mean aggregation treats all modes uniformly, and probability-weighted aggregation follows the predicted scene probabilities. The contingency strategy combines these views temporally: it uses worst-case costs before the branching time and probability-weighted costs afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 展示了场景模式成本在聚类混合前如何聚合。 Top-1 聚合仅使用最可能的场景模式，最坏情况聚合取所有场景模式中的最大值，均值聚合对所有模式一视同仁，而概率加权聚合则遵循预测的场景概率。 应急策略在时间上结合了这些视角：它在分支时间之前使用最坏情况成本，之后则使用概率加权成本。

sents.en: Table 11 ablates how the scene-mode costs are aggregated before cluster mixing.
sents.zh: 表 11 展示了场景模式成本在聚类混合前如何聚合。

sents.en: Top-1 aggregation uses only the most likely scene mode, worst-case aggregation takes the maximum over scene modes, mean aggregation treats all modes uniformly, and probability-weighted aggregation follows the predicted scene probabilities.

sents.en: The contingency strategy combines these views temporally: it uses worst-case costs before the branching time and probability-weighted costs afterward.
sents.zh: 应急策略在时间上结合了这些视角：它在分支时间之前使用最坏情况成本，之后则使用概率加权成本。

paragraphs.en: The aggregation strategy has a clear effect on both planning accuracy and safety. Top-1 and probability-weighted aggregation commit strongly to likely scene modes and can therefore underemphasize low-probability but safety-critical futures. Worst-case aggregation avoids this optimism, but applying the maximum over all scene modes for the full horizon can be overly conservative and does not improve collision in this setting. Uniform mean aggregation provides a moderate compromise, reducing collision relative to Top-1 and worst-case aggregation, but it ignores the different roles of early and late planning timesteps.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合策略对规划准确度和安全性都有明显影响。 Top-1 和概率加权聚合会强烈倾向于高概率的场景模式，因此可能会低估低概率但对安全至关重要的未来状态。 最坏情况聚合避免了这种过度乐观，但在全时间范围内对所有场景模式取最大值可能过于保守，且在此设置下无法改善碰撞问题。 均匀均值聚合提供了一种折中的方案，与 Top-1 和最坏情况聚合相比减少了碰撞，但它忽略了早期和晚期规划时间步长的不同作用。

paragraphs.en: The contingency aggregation performs best across all metrics. By using worst-case costs before the branching time, it keeps early ego actions safe under multiple plausible futures.
